LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonNerveNodeDesignatorDesc: Grow a local command organ for the flesh moon. It stores the moon's hemogel reserve and coordinates hauling tendrils.
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonDesignatorOnlyOnMoon: This can only be used inside the flesh moon.
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonNerveNodeAlreadyExists: The flesh moon already has a nerve node.
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonNerveNodeBlocked: Requires a clear 3x3 area of flesh floor.
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonTileDrainToggleDesc: Allow anchored celestial umbilici to drain world tile nutrition into the lunar hemogel reserve.
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonSurfaceNutritionDrainEconomy: Disabled at the lunar nerve node; tile nutrition {0}%.
LanguageData.FB_CelestialUmbilicusTileDrainDisabledIn: Location drain: disabled at the lunar nerve node.
LanguageData.FB_CelestialUmbilicusDevTileNutritionIns: DEV tile nutrition: {0}% remaining; initial factor {1}; effective factor {2}.
LanguageData.FB_CelestialUmbilicusDevDrainSpeedToolti: Changes surface nutrition drain speed for testing. Current multiplier: x{0}. Applies only while dev gizmos are visible; normal play uses x1.
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonGastricAcidCreateDesc: Turn flesh floor inside the moon into gastric acid. Organic matter left in it feeds the lunar hemogel reserve.
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonGastricAcidRemoveDesc: Absorb gastric acid inside the moon and restore flesh floor.
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonGastricAcidAlreadyHere: There is already gastric acid here.
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonGastricAcidMissing: There is no gastric acid here.
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonGastricAcidBlocked: Cannot form gastric acid under a building.
LanguageData.FB_FleshMoonGastricAcidDigester_Inspect: Lunar digestive fuel: {0} nutrition. Hemogel output: {1}/h.
LanguageData.FB_BiomassTransformNoHeartOnFleshMoon: You cannot grow a Flesh Heart inside the flesh moon. Instead, grow a lunar nerve node from the Build menu's Flesh moon tab.
